purpose: A reader who comes looking finds the right book, page and quote.

number.name: reach_30d
number.source: distinct book_id in analytics_events book_read + page_read, traffic_class human, resolved to live books by _id or id

companion.name: site_search_to_read_30m
companion.source: analytics_events search_query (global + unified, sourcelibrary.org, browser UAs, deduped IP+query) followed by a read from the same IP within 30 min

outside_check: Cloudflare edge crawl detector (PR #6423) for bot inflation (11.5% of 'human' search events are MCP/script UAs; reads carry no UA); scripts/eval/search-recall/run.mjs (30 queries + 42-query nav suite) for relevance, last run 2026-10-06, not scheduled

queue.title: BPH reading room search intermittently answers empty (fail-closed tenant scope); make the purity audit fail on an empty tenant arm
queue.why: A partner's readers see 'no results' for alchemy in the BPH's own reading room, and the audit reports PASS
queue.measure: empty answers per probe run on bph.sourcelibrary.org (2026-10-10: up to 4/4 for ~45 min)

queue.title: Catalogue tab: 8 of 20 subject options return 0 books in the 'on Source Library' view; show per-subject counts and drop or annotate empty options
queue.why: Readers pick Astrology, Sufism, Buddhism or Anthroposophy from our own menu and get nothing; 35.5% of catalogue searches end at zero
queue.measure: catalogue-tab zero-result rate (2,062/5,804 = 35.5%, 30d to 2026-10-11)

queue.title: Build the untranslated-pages index in production and switch the lane on after its two verification commands pass (decided 2026-10-10)
queue.why: Books with text but no English are opened at 3.9% (377/9,546) vs 68-74% for translated ones
queue.measure: 30d reach of rung 'transcribed' books (377/9,546)

queue.title: Finish the running re-embed window (1.23M stale/empty page vectors, ~$67 of $95) and the #6270 items 1 and 3
queue.why: Semantic search returns pages by text they no longer hold; finishing in-flight paid work ranks first
queue.measure: page_translations rows drifting from a fresh embed (~56% before)

queue.title: 12,542 live books with non-Latin-script titles are dark to English search (english_title 5.4% populated)
queue.why: A reader typing an English title cannot find most Chinese, Tibetan or Arabic books we hold
queue.measure: live books with english_title; 30d reach of non-Latin-title books

queue.title: Diagnose why translated pages that say the query nearly verbatim return 'No strong matches' (Fludd p.57, Bodhicaryavatara p.13)
queue.why: The exact page a reader describes is in the library and translated, but search says nothing matches
queue.measure: both probe queries return the page in the top 10; search-recall eval recall@10

queue.title: Classify MCP and script user agents (SourceLibrary-MCP, node, Python, Playwright) as non-human in classifyRequest()
queue.why: 11.5% of 'human' search events are tools, so every Found number is inflated and unauditable
queue.measure: share of human-class search_query events with non-browser UA (5,289/45,816)

queue.title: The two owed small PRs: typeahead prefixes stop counting toward the anonymous 5/hour wall; name matches still returned at the wall
queue.why: A reader typing a title burns the anonymous allowance letter by letter and then gets nothing
queue.measure: nav-suite recall@k (42 queries); searches answered empty at the wall

queue.title: Within a work, let the readable or translated edition represent it in search and on the map (today the oldest copy wins)
queue.why: Readers land on the unreadable copy when a readable one exists
queue.measure: share of top-20 results that are the work's readable edition when one exists

queue.title: Schedule the site-search recall eval weekly against prod and post the delta (scripts/eval/search-recall/run.mjs, both suites)
queue.why: The outside check for this area's number exists but has not run against prod since 2026-10-06
queue.measure: recall@10 (30 queries) and nav recall@3 (42 queries), weekly

queue.title: The Secret Teachings of All Ages: the titled record is hidden, the visible copy is catalogued under its subtitle; a reader hit a 404 (feedback 2026-10-07)
queue.why: The first title a reader asked for by name could not be found though we hold it
queue.measure: known-item search for the title returns the visible copy

queue.title: Name spelling variants (Drebbel / Drebelius / Kufler): ship the merged_into read redirect, then the merge
queue.why: A reader searching one spelling misses most books by the same person
queue.measure: books returned for 'Drebbel' (9 of ~200 before #5905)

queue.title: Close #5905: split the concept-query gap ('self-regulating oven') into its own retrieval issue (default taken 2026-10-07)
queue.why: The open issue hides a distinct retrieval gap behind a finished ranking fix
queue.measure: issue split and closed

queue.title: Check the snippet page number vs get_quote page number off-by-one (Agrippa 1550)
queue.why: A quote cited from a search snippet may point at the wrong page
queue.measure: snippet page = get_quote page on a 50-query sample

queue.title: search_translations: port the search_within_book ranking (score, proximity, IDF)
queue.why: AI clients quoting for readers get unranked passages
queue.measure: MCP search_translations precision@5 on a fixed query set

queue.title: SEO remainder: noindex /auth pages; log Googlebot crawls (JSON-LD on /work shipped in #6408)
queue.why: Google is the largest external door (9,382 referred pageviews in 30d) and we cannot see what it reads
queue.measure: /auth URLs in the index; Googlebot pages/day recorded

queue.title: Indexable pages phase 2 (393,916 of 19.1M after phase 1 on 2026-09-24)
queue.why: Translated pages that are the only English version anywhere cannot be found from a search engine
queue.measure: seo_indexable pages; search-engine-referred pageviews (15,451/30d)

queue.title: Re-measure collection reachability (294/325 unreachable on 2026-08-29) and link orphan collections from their parents
queue.why: Curated collections a reader cannot reach by browsing do not serve curation
queue.measure: collections reachable from /collections by link (31/325 on 2026-08-29)

queue.title: Re-measure /search rageclicks now that the browser-translation crash (#3409) is closed; fix what remains
queue.why: Controls that do not respond on the search page stop a reader at the door
queue.measure: rageclicks on /search per 30d (218 from 51 users before)

queue.title: Bhutan reading room: 84% of site searches return zero (107/128); say on the zero state that the shelf is scoped
queue.why: Readers there look for books the main library holds and get a blank page with no explanation
queue.measure: zero-result rate on bhutan.sourcelibrary.org

queue.title: Search within one library's illustrations (BPH), asked by a reader 2026-09-26
queue.why: A reader asked for it directly
queue.measure: illustration searches scoped to a library

queue.title: Exclude <meta> editorial wrappers from the pages_search Atlas index
queue.why: Meta-only matches outrank pages that actually say the words
queue.measure: share of top-10 page hits whose match is only in <meta>

queue.title: search_concept / search_translations: per-author and per-work caps
queue.why: Edition-heavy authors swamp cross-author answers for AI clients
queue.measure: distinct authors in top-10 on a fixed concept set

queue.title: Give artwork search its own Atlas index (1.2 s collection scan today)
queue.why: Image search is slow enough to time out under load
queue.measure: artwork search p50 latency

queue.title: Entity pages: decide what the 773K single-book entity pages are for (thin content at scale), with #4321
queue.why: Thin pages dilute what search engines show readers from us
queue.measure: indexed entity pages that meet the published predicate
